title: GEMATI-CARE: Uncertainty-Aware Conformal Routing for Mental-Health Crisis Escalation (code, model, and results)
description: Source code, configuration, trained model bundle, figure scripts, and machine-readable results accompanying the article GEMATI-CARE: Uncertainty-Aware Conformal Routing Reduces Missed Mental-Health Crisis Escalations (submitted to Jurnal RESTI). GEMATI-CARE converts calibrated risk probabilities into class-conditional (Mondrian) conformal prediction sets and routes each message to SUPPORT, CLARIFY, or ESCALATE by minimizing the worst-case engineering cost. On the official CRADLE Bench test set, the router reduced the high-risk miss rate from 23.50% (argmax) to 5.13% at alpha = 0.05. Version 1.1.0 adds the revision analyses (matched threshold, class-specific significance levels, clinician-label recalibration, McNemar and paired bootstrap tests, five-seed coverage tests, and a CPU benchmark of the TF-IDF classifier) with scripts, logs, and checksums. The pipeline runs on a CPU. The public datasets are not redistributed. This is an offline research prototype, not a diagnostic or triage tool.
